svg.title: LAFINA local database entity–relationship diagram
svg.desc: Schema 28; 36 application tables. All declared columns, primary and unique keys, SQL foreign keys, and logical references. See lafina-erd.md for full definitions and semantics.

g.title: LAFINA
g.text: 36 application tables | all declared columns | Android lafina.db
PK / PK1..n = primary key | FK = declared foreign key | UQ = single-column unique key
NN = explicit NOT NULL | LR = logical reference | PR = polymorphic reference (neither is an FK)
Solid crow's-foot = SQL FK (one parent; zero or one / many children). Dashed arrow = logical reference only.
Repeated user_id LR lines are omitted: each refers to users.id. See the companion schema guide for constraints and polymorphic links.
